name: TRX Gold (Buckreef, Tanzania; 55/45 STAMICO JV)
verdict: REJECT / FLAT — no position, no gate, no ladder
recommendation: REJECT. The thesis ('13x screen masks a 5-6x business') is arithmetic that cancels. Blue sustained red at 9/10 and verified TO THE DOLLAR that the published $404M EV adds book NCI to the numerator while the headline adj-EBITDA keeps 100% of earnings in the denominator: honoring the 45% NCI gives ~11.5x EBITDA (within 12% of the screen's 13.1x), ~23x attributable OCF, and — blue's decisive new finding — ~34x attributable EARNINGS at record $4,703/oz gold, because the clean Q3 allocated 66% of net income to NCI (parent carries 100% of G&A/exploration). 9M FCF negative (capex $23.0M corrected), cash taxes $0 (30% Tanzanian CIT ahead of run-rate), stockpile growing not converting, 'significant undrawn credit lines' = $2.1M undrawn of a $5.0M Stanbic facility against a $45-50M transcript-only capex program. Funded prize clears +50% only above ~$4,700/oz.
kill_class_census: 3 NOVEL / 0 CONSENSUS (blue contested red's CONSENSUS tag on #1: the 55/45 fact is known but no published source applies it — stockanalysis ADDS NCI to EV)
named_kill: consolidated-EBITDA-minority-owned-asset + parent-cost-center NCI amplification: attributable multiple ~= screen multiple; the dispersion does not exist.
recourt_triggers: a FILED 6-K executing a JV restructuring (transcript talk doesn't count — blue found red's 'advanced talks' UNSOURCED)
FY26 40-F showing OCF >=$45M with the stockpile converted and cash taxes still nil under a ruling-confirmed shield
the 3,500+ tpd study document confirming >=90koz steady-state with a funded, non-dilutive capex path

pre_mortem: Pass-risk: gold runs past $5,000 and the multiple question stops mattering — beta carries it regardless of NCI arithmetic.
The JV restructures on undisclosed terms (Tanzania's 2023-25 framework deals recut several mining JVs) — a governance option we priced at zero because it was unsourced.

Venue risk: four multi_venue fires in one court — management's promotional channel runs well ahead of its filed one; a name like this can re-rate on transcript claims alone before any filing catches up.
what_could_go_wrong.sentence: If this REJECT costs us, the most likely reason will be gold running past five thousand while the JV restructures on terms we said were unsourced — beta plus a governance option we priced at zero.
